description:
Use this when the user wants their saved posting setups: "what presets do I have", "show my saved post
        settings", "use my usual YouTube settings". Returns each preset the user saved in the RipClip composer: its
        name, caption template, whether links are tagged and, per connected account, the platform, format and
        settings. Takes no parameters.
        Not for: putting a preset on a draft (update_draft with post_preset) or saved clip styles (edit_catalog with
        kind templates). Free and read only.
name: list_post_presets
title: List posting presets
